items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: So, on that time I was there, Ike told him, say, well listen, our violin player will play that for you.

ctx.x: Did you play many wagon jobs with other bands sometimes? Oh yes. Just anyone that would happen to play?

Yes, I played, I'll tell you, the scene on the job, I played at Arborville. Oh yes, you were. Well it happened once the Shriners came to town. I had two bartenders at McIshies. I had a day bartender and a night bartender. Well, the night bartender, him and his lady friend, they were live parties. They'd go out shopping and they'd stop in the 10 cent store. During that time the Shriners was here and the pop, the piece of the Shriners was a long way to Tipperary and people was buying them songs, man, like hotcakes.…
What did you wear exactly? What did you wear? Huh? What did you wear exactly?
